metadata.title: How primitive tribe gathers food from the Jungle | पहाड़िया जंगल से कैसे खाना जुटाते हैं
metadata.description: Paharia tribe is among one of the particularly vulnerable tribes of the country. These tribals are settled in the forests on the mountains of Santal Parganas of Jharkhand. These tribals practice agriculture. But even today, the forest is very important for their livelihood and food.
